About this item

  • 🔋 Reliable Portable Power – 173Wh Lithium Battery: Stay powered anywhere with 200W AC output (250W surge), perfect for charging laptops, phones, cameras, and small appliances during camping, road trips, or emergencies.
  • ⚡ Multiple Charging Options for Ultimate Convenience: Recharge via solar panel (13-26V, not included), wall outlet (7-9 hours), or car charger, ensuring you have power anytime, anywhere.
  • 🔌 Versatile Output Ports for All Your Devices: Features USB-C, USB-A, 12V DC, and AC outlets, allowing you to power phones, tablets, CPAP machines, car appliances, LED lights, and more with ease.
  • 🌟 Compact, Lightweight & Travel-Friendly: Weighing only 3.3 lbs, this portable power station is designed for easy carrying—ideal for camping, RV trips, outdoor work, and emergency backup power.
  • 🔦 Built-in LED Flashlight & Smart Safety System: Equipped with ultra-bright LED lights for emergencies and an advanced cooling system to prevent overheating, ensuring safe and reliable power anytime you need it.

Product description

Battery Capacity 173Wh, Equivalent to 46,800mAh at 3.7V
AC Output 110V, 200W (250W Max)
DC Output 2x DC, 12V/10A (120W)
USB Output 2x USB 5V, Total 3.1A Max
USB-C 5-9V/2A (18W)
Input Charging DC 15V/2A Adapter included.
Solar Charging Input DC 13-26V, 2A Max
Recharging Temp 32°F~104°F
Operature Temp 14°F~104°F
Dimension 7.8 x 4.3 x 5 inches
Weight 3.4 lbs
LED Light 2x LED Flashlight

  • How do I know if my device is compatible with the AIMTOM SPS-200 power station?

    The SPS-200’s AC outlet supports devices up to 200W. The 12V DC port supports up to 120W, and the USB-C port supports up to 18W. Please ensure your device's power requirement does not exceed these limits.

  • Can I bring this power station on an airplane?

    No, the SPS-200 exceeds the battery size allowed on commercial flights and cannot be brought aboard an airplane.

  • Is this power station waterproof?

    No, the SPS-200 is not waterproof. Keep it dry and avoid rain, snow, water, or extreme heat. For camping, use it inside a tent, RV, or dry, shaded area.

  • What type of solar panels are compatible with this unit?

    You can use third-party solar panels with a Voltage Open Circuit (Voc) between 13V and 26V DC. For best performance, we recommend a 30W to 60W solar panel.

  • How long can this power station run my device using the AC outlet?

    You can estimate the runtime with this formula:

    Runtime = (173Wh × 0.85) ÷ Device Wattage

    For example, if your device uses 20W:

    (173 × 0.85) ÷ 20 = approx. 7.36 hours

    (The 0.85 accounts for power conversion efficiency.)

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Great value and quality!!
This is a great little solar generator, it’s very light weight, but yet seems to be made of good quality. With the large capacity it has more than enough juice to recharge devices during a camping/fishing trip. For the price your not going to beat this device. If you elected to get the solar panels with this you would have power indefinitely. It’s easy to use, you have one side that is all of your outlet plugs one Ac plug ”wall outlet plug” ,3 usb and 3 dc plugs. Then on the other side you have your single dc inlet used to charge the device. It comes with a wall charger, and car charger, as well as an adapter plug that allows you to run any of your existing “cigarette lighter plug” devices. Last but not least it also has a nice little flashlight. lol If your looking for a solid solar generator that is compact and easy to use, with a large capacity, then look no further! Add on a solar panel from these guys and your set for an extended camping trip with the comfort of all your favorite devices!

    5.0 out of 5 stars Great Buy, Even IF Not Every 5-Star Works For Everybody!
    Reviewed in the United States on July 27, 2018
    Color: SPS155Verified Purchase
    Wow! Talk about a vendor determined to make the customer happy! I use a CPAP machine and am about to depart on a 70-day trip, some of which will be primitive camping (no electricity). This "solar generator" interested me because it can charge directly from a solar panel. I know little about solar - I live in the big woods - but adding this option to car charging was very attractive. I also ordered a well-rated 50 watt solar panel. After consulting with Aimtom and the panel tech people I also ordered an Aimtom direct to solar panel connector (MC 4 on Solar side and 5mm round on Aimtom side). Unfortunately, my solar panel may have been too much for the Aimtom, or, it is incompatible in some other way I'm unaware of, and, after a few hours in partial sunlight, the Aimtom no longer charged by any method. That is NOT a slam on the Aimtom; their specs say there is a limit to the input and I (unknowingly) exceeded that limit. Long story shorter; I returned the Aimtom via UPS on Tuesday, sent the tracking number to Aimtom and they immediately sent me a replacement, which I received Thursday! I could get a smaller, say 30-watt, panel, in the future and hook it directly, we'll see (how much am I willing to spend for additional gear?) and; for now I'm happy to have this along. DO LOOK HARD AT THIS PRODUCT: looks and feels very durable, it can provide DC (cigarette lighter-style), USB and household (2 -3 prong & international) output and it runs my CPAP for around 12 hours (no humidity)! I would also contact Aimtom for solar panel input; they provided an example of a product other customers use successfully (and, no; not one of their products). BOTTOM LINE: HI QUALITY VENDOR AND PRODUCT!!

  • thearchiteck
    5.0 out of 5 stars Great unit for off-grid, lots of useful power output types that come in handy
    Reviewed in Canada on August 8, 2019
    Color: SPS155Verified Purchase
    We use the Aimtom to power strips of LED lights in a mobile pop-up shop as well as provide power to an off grid tiny home for lighting, charging phones and computers.

    We are really happy with the product, it runs the LEDs with no problem and it was super easy to wire up a barrel jack to use with the 12V DC output. Having three jacks available makes it easy to prioritize which strips of light we want to run and when the battery is getting lower we can just unplug one or two strips to ensure the light will last longer. Also nice that we can plug into AC power and charge the unit while the lights are running.

    The short-circuit protection has come in handy a few times where the LED wiring has failed, but simply plugging the Aimtom in will reset the circuit and everything works again immediately. We reached out for support for another issue we were having and they responded promptly and offered solutions right away.

    The unit is smaller and more lightweight than expected and is really a perfect solution for a weekend camper or remote power source. I think we will be buying a second unit, maybe the larger one to have on hand to swap in and out as this one can sometimes drain fairly quickly when you have multiple loads connected. Since we are off-grid and remote we don't always have access to AC power to recharge. We will be getting the solar add-ons soon to help keep the unit charged and easier to set it and forget it!

  • Morgan
    5.0 out of 5 stars Great value lithium power pack.
    Reviewed in Canada on September 8, 2018
    Color: SPS155Verified Purchase
    I use this device to power a few 5 watt LED lights in an off grid cabin. It typically lasts about a week on a full charge with fairly limited use in this scenario. I usually leave the inverter turned on all night, in case I need to switch a light on during the night, then turn it off when I leave in the morning. If nothing is drawing current then it doesn't lose much charge even with the inverter left on, though it will lose charge in about 3 days even with no draw if you leave the inverter running continuously. It's much smaller than I expected, so performs very well for it's small size. Extremely light and portable unlike lead acid batteries. It takes about 6 hours or so to fully charge when fully discharged. It is silent in my situation as I don't draw much current the fans (if it has any) never turn on.

Product Description

AIMTOM PowerPal 200 Portable Power Station – Reliable Power Anywhere, Anytime Stay powered up wherever you go with the AIMTOM PowerPal 200 Portable Power Station. Whether you're camping, traveling, facing an emergency, or needing a backup power source at home or in your RV, this 173Wh lithium battery power station is designed to keep your essential devices running. *High-Capacity & Versatile Power Output 173Wh Lithium Battery: Delivers dependable power for phones, laptops, cameras, and small appliances. 200W AC Outlet (250W Surge): Run essential AC-powered devices with ease. Multiple Charging Ports: Includes USB-C, USB-A, and DC outputs for fast and flexible charging. 12V DC Output: Ideal for car appliances, LED lights, and more. *Multiple Recharging Options Solar Charging: Supports 13-26V solar panels (not included) for off-grid power. Wall Outlet Charging: Fully recharges in 7-9 hours via the included AC adapter. Car Charging: Use the car charger for on-the-go power (best used when the car engine is running). *Built for Convenience & Safety Ultra-Bright LED Flashlights: Built-in LED lights for emergencies and nighttime use. Smart Cooling System: Prevents overheating with efficient air vents and fans. Compact & Lightweight: Weighs only 3.3 lbs, making it easy to carry anywhere. Intelligent Battery Management: Protects against overload, overheating, and short circuits. *Perfect for: ✔ Camping & Outdoor Adventures – Power your lights, cameras, and phones off the grid. ✔ Emergency Backup Power – Keep essential devices running during power outages. ✔ Road Trips & RV Use – Charge gadgets and small appliances on the move. ✔ Work & Travel – A reliable power source for remote work setups. *What’s Included? 1 x AIMTOM PowerPal 200 Portable Power Station 1 x AC Adapter 1 x Car Charging Cable 1 x Cigarette Lighter Output Adapter 1 x User Manual Be prepared for any situation with the AIMTOM PowerPal 200 Portable Power Station—your compact, lightweight, and powerful energy solution.
